description: Saves a new glaze recipe in your Glazecalc account, from its base materials and amounts (the library's names, or your own materials'), with optional colorants, notes, firing band and food-surface mark. Glazecalc works out its unity formula, as the recipe page does, and answers with it. Save only a recipe the person asked to save. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

colorants.description: Colorants and opacifiers added to the base, as the recipe page lists them; left out of the unity formula.

name.description: The colorant or opacifier, by its name in your additives or the Glazecalc library ("Cobalt Carbonate").

unit.description: Percent of the base recipe (the default), parts, or grams.

firing.description: The firing band its limits are checked in: low (cone 06-02), mid (cone 4-6), high (cone 9-11) or top (cone 12 up, where no limit set has figures, so none are checked), as the recipe page chooses it.

foodSurface.description: Whether it is meant for a food surface (a liner).

language.description: The language for any sentences in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag such as "en", "de" or "ja". Languages Glazecalc does not offer are answered in English.

lines.description: The recipe's base materials (not colorants), at most 40 lines.

amount.description: Its amount in the recipe, in any unit the other lines share (grams, parts, percent).

analysis.description: Only for a material not in the library: its oxides in weight percent, as { "SiO2": 68.5, "Al2O3": 17.4 }.

loi.description: Its loss on ignition in percent, with an analysis.

material.description: The material, by its name in the Glazecalc library ("Custer Spar", "Whiting", "EPK"), or your own name when you give its analysis.

name: create_recipe
title: Save a new recipe
